decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's core machining offer and fits its automation strategy, so keeping it costs little while demand for automation is still uncertain but promising.
The dual-table loading system builds on established machines and shares their service and parts infrastructure, so keeping this option open after only one year is cheap.

Although the dispensing machine is distant from the core business and therefore more uncertain, its dedicated page and Red Dot award are early positive signals that justify keeping the option open while market results unfold.
